What else is added to the package price?
Only those approach and which: VAT. We calculate the journey from Gelsenkirchen by route, team size and necessary overnight stays – it is transparent in the offer.
With the order confirmation, a deposit of 30% is due – then design and approval start. The rest is transferred within two weeks of the show.
What happens if the show goes down?

If bad weather is foreseeable, we postpone without additional charge – only an already incurred journey will be charged. The show is completely out , we keep the deposit, because design and approval are then already done.

As a rule of thumb: SPARK up to 150 drones with motifs from our catalogue, HORIZON for individual animations and logos, ODYSSEY for large campaigns with 3D and storytelling. If in doubt, we will advise you in the video call.
